description: Résultats des élections au Comité d'Entreprise is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Résultats des élections des membres du Comité d’Entreprise depuis 1996. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Social et ressources humaines. Its keywords are Social, Elections, Comité d'entreprise, Direction Cohésion. The portal shows 2022-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
